name: Lennar Corporation
summary:
Lennar (LEN) reported earnings of $1.23 per share on revenue of $8.05 billion for the fiscal third quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.29 per share on revenue of $8.33 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.28 per share. The company missed expectations by 3.91% while revenue fell 8.67% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it expects fourth-quarter homebuilding revenue of $8.14 billion to $8.74 billion. The current consensus revenue estimate is $9.38 billion for the quarter ending November 30, 2026.

Stuart Miller, Executive Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and President of Lennar, said, "Our third quarter 2026 results reflect consistent focus on our operating strategy of maintaining volume and production while navigating a challenging economic environment. While our earnings of $1.19 per share were below expectations, they reflect the nature of the environment in which we are operating, which has deteriorated since our last earnings call."

Lennar Corporation is one of the nation's leading builders of quality homes for all generations. Lennar builds affordable, move-up and active adult homes primarily under the Lennar brand name.
subject: Lennar Missed Expectations

name: Ispire Technology Inc.
summary:
Ispire Technology Inc. (ISPR) reported a loss of $0.24 per share on revenue of $26.68 million for the fiscal fourth quarter ended June 2026. . Revenue grew 32.50% on a year-over-year basis.

Ispire is engaged in the research and development, design, commercialization, sales, marketing, and distribution of branded e-cigarettes and cannabis vaping products.

name: LuxExperience B.V.
summary:
LuxExperience B.V. (LUXE) reported a loss of $0.04 per share on revenue of $771.70 million for the fiscal fourth quarter ended June 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.11 per share on revenue of $727.39 million. The Earnings Whisper number was a loss of $0.14 per share. The company beat expectations by 71.43% while revenue grew 15.71% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fiscal 2027 revenue of $2.989 billion to $3.147 billion. The current consensus revenue estimate is $3.00 billion for the year ending June 30, 2027.

LuxExperience is the leading digital, multi-brand luxury group and the online shopping destination for luxury enthusiasts worldwide.
